title: AGI ALPHA FLYWHEEL — When Capability Creates Opportunity
subtitle: Transformational Intelligence, Experience-Trained Specialists and the Expanding Frontier of Profitable Work
author: Vincent Boucher — President of MONTREAL.AI
design: Small prospective hosted-agent software-repair pilot plus separately labeled conditional economic experiment
unit_of_analysis: one independently specified software-maintenance mission, not each hidden assertion

arms.H: human service reference: sourced backend hourly rate plus explicitly assumed scope hours; no human trial or quote
arms.U: same hosted frontier agent, reasonable task request, ordinary Python/editor/test tools and correction; proxy for ordinary tool-equipped model use, not a sample of ordinary human users
arms.E: same hosted model/tool access plus frozen researcher-authored expert_v1 method
arms.E_plus: same E method plus a development-origin reusable contract-probe artifact, received by a fresh separate recipient

observable_budget_warning: Equal access and outer limits do not establish equal hidden reasoning compute or token consumption. Report matched observable envelope only.
acceptance: Complete fixed public API contract and all pre-frozen independent critical checks; original task identity preserved. Record per-category failures and public tests separately. No hidden-result feedback during confirmation.
deliverable: patched module, canonical public and added regression tests, REPAIR.md scope and limitations
confirmation_policy: Freeze workflows, benchmark/source hashes, acceptance, budget and participant instructions before evaluating fresh submissions. No tuning on confirmation. Keep every submitted output and failure.
participant_isolation: Separate fresh context per arm, no shared solver history, no reading other arms/private acceptance or references. Protocol isolation is auditable through logged interface, not claimed as OS-level protection.
analysis: paired task acceptance without pseudoreplication of assertions
cost per accepted output only where costs are known; otherwise null and sensitivity
E minus U and E_plus minus E separately
recipient observed benefit versus its unobserved counterfactual explicitly distinguished
inference_limits: four researcher-authored missions and one run per arm
no immutable API snapshot or metered billing
same model family but unexposed server variability
technical correctness within finite contract is not production authorization
not a test of human job displacement
new_offering_gate: A predeclared complete four-component repair pack qualifies only if all four tasks accept within the common envelope, delivered artifacts exist, and an explicitly stated complete-cost scenario yields positive margin. Actual commercial crossing cannot be established with unknown actual cost or demand.
history_policy: Earlier definitions, source, unsuccessful results and corrections remain unchanged. No reclassification of earlier competent Beta profits or retrospective recovered profit.
native_admission: Existing minimum six paired clusters and complete monetary evidence are not satisfied by a four-task unmetered pilot. Retention in research artifacts is not native production admission.
supplementary_offering: Separately frozen c5 campaign-recovery auditor; same verified four components supplied to every arm only after all primary submissions are frozen. Same invention menu and buyer hypotheses; no primary result replacement.
